title: The 6 Best Strollers for Newborns
metaDescription: Our 6 picks for strollers for newborns, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at strollers for newborns using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: UPPAbaby Vista V2 Stroller
products.blurb: Key specs: Included bassinet rated from birth to 20 lbs, One-step fold, stands on its own when folded, Converts to single-to-double system with add-on seats.
strengths: Included bassinet gives a genuinely flat, crib-like surface, no separate purchase needed
Grows from bassinet to toddler seat to a double stroller for a second child
One-step fold works with the bassinet or toddler seat still attached
Large, adjustable canopy with a mesh panel for airflow on warm days
limitations: Bulkier and heavier than umbrella-style or compact strollers
Bassinet is an included accessory, not the everyday seat, so it still needs the toddler seat purchased or swapped later
features: Included bassinet rated from birth to 20 lbs
One-step fold, stands on its own when folded
Converts to single-to-double system with add-on seats
Extendable UPF 50+ canopy with mesh peekaboo window
Compatible with Mesa, Aria, and most major infant car seats via adapter

products.name: Graco Modes Pramette Stroller
products.blurb: Key specs: True pram mode with flat-lying reversible seat, 3-in-1: car seat carrier, pramette, toddler stroller, One-hand fold.
strengths: True pram mode is a rare feature at this price, most competitors only offer deep recline
Reversible seat lets the newborn face the parent, a preferred orientation for young infants
One-hand fold is fast for solo parents managing a newborn and a stroller at once
limitations: Car seat sold separately on the stroller-only version
Pram mode compartment is smaller than a dedicated bassinet attachment
Storage basket is smaller than full-size competitors
features: True pram mode with flat-lying reversible seat
3-in-1: car seat carrier, pramette, toddler stroller
One-hand fold
Removable child tray with cup holders
Compatible with Graco SnugRide infant car seats

products.name: Chicco Bravo Trio Travel System
products.blurb: Key specs: Includes Chicco KeyFit 30 infant car seat and base, Click-in car seat with no adapter needed, One-hand, self-standing fold.
strengths: KeyFit 30 is a top-rated infant car seat on its own, so this is two well-reviewed products in one box
No adapter required, the car seat clicks directly onto the stroller frame
Self-standing fold means it won't tip over when folded in a trunk or hallway
limitations: Heavier overall than stroller-only options once the car seat is attached
Toddler seat recline is deep but not a true flat pram mode
Bulkier fold than umbrella-style compact strollers
features: Includes Chicco KeyFit 30 infant car seat and base
Click-in car seat with no adapter needed
One-hand, self-standing fold
4-wheel suspension
UPF 50+ canopy with peekaboo mesh window

products.name: Baby Jogger City Mini GT2 Travel System
products.blurb: Key specs: Includes City GO 2 infant car seat, Forever-air rubber tires, never go flat, All-wheel suspension.
strengths: All-wheel suspension smooths out sidewalk cracks and uneven pavement for a sleeping newborn
Forever-air tires remove the risk of a flat during regular use
One-hand fold and auto-lock are genuinely fast to operate one-handed while holding a baby
Grows with the child well past the newborn stage, up to 65 lbs
limitations: No true bassinet or pram mode, relies entirely on the included car seat for newborns
Wider footprint than compact strollers, less ideal for narrow doorways
